code_evidence: PreparedPass1TerminalContextProjection.ShouldProject currently makes turn ten terminal unless a first rejection occurred earlier.
PreparedPass1JobExecutor invokes a sole submission on turn ten and then sets context.Terminate regardless of validity.
The existing first-invalid-on-turn-ten fake test expects rejection with ten requests and no request eleven.
A correction succeeds when the first invalid submission occurs before turn ten, as the second diagnostic run proved.
root_cause: AD-29 authorized two submission attempts inside ten provider turns but retained AD-23's use of provider turn ten for a possible first submission. When the model spends turns one through nine navigating or exhausting navigation and its first candidate on turn ten is locally invalid, the executor correctly refuses request eleven, making the authorized correction unreachable. Provider output variability only determines whether this deterministic scheduling hole is exercised.
